text:
marta: Quick sync — planning a minor release bump (v2.18.5) tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Need to lock cutoffs and ops-latch windows for US/EU/APAC. TL;DR: shadow canary in APAC, EU canary 03:30-04:00 UTC, US ramp 05:00-06:30 UTC. Ping ops/qa.

raj: Can you confirm branch freeze/cutoff times and which branch we tag from?

marta: Freeze: cut release branch at 01:00 UTC tomorrow. Branch name: release/v2.18. All PRs must be merged before cutoff. Tag will be created from that branch. Changelog: add entries under Unreleased.

li: Noted. I will nudge reviews around 23:00 PT. Any DB migrations or infra changes?

marta: No DB migrations. Just a model weights roll + config tweak (rate limiter defaults). Canary in APAC is a shadow run (0% traffic) for 30m to validate logs/metrics, then if green we'll open 5% traffic.

ed: Ops question — can ops latch for the full window 02:30–07:00 UTC? Oncall coverage needed.

sophie: I can take 03:00–05:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rollout job created: job_id=rbw-1951234, canary_window=03:00-04:00 UTC, job_url=https://ci.redwood/jobs/rbw-1951234

raj: Please add the rollback playbook link to the thread: https://wiki.redwood/rollbacks/v2.18

marta: Bump steps (copy/paste):
```
# create release branch and tag
git checkout -b release/v2.18
git merge --no-ff main
git tag -a v2.18.5 -m "v2.18.5 release"
git push origin release/v2.18 && git push origin v2.18.5
```
Also: update CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased and add short note about streaming-api param fix.

li: :thumbsup: I'll kick off the canary dashboards and eval runs. Abort criteria: latency p95 > 2x baseline for 5m OR error-rate > 1%.

ed: I'll add an alert rule: `canary.latency.p95 > 2*baseline for 5m` and `canary.errors.rate > 1% for 3m`.

sophie: For EU canary smoke tests I'll run: `/run smoke-suite --env=eu-canary` — will paste results here.

raj: Who does final sign-off for production traffic ramp?

marta: Sign-offs required: eng-lead (raj), qa (li), ops (ed). Ramp plan: A/B at 5% for 15m -> 25% for 15m -> 50% then full if metrics stable.

li: Heads-up: changelog entry missing for "streaming api param" — pinging @dan to add docs snippet.

dan: On it, adding a short example and changelog blurb now.

oncall-ops: oncall-ops: adding deploy window to schedule and pager coverage. If times change update me asap.

marta: If we hit any blocker after 05:30 UTC we'll pause and fallback to previous tag v2.18.4. Routing will pin v2.18.4 for immediate rollback.

raj: :eyes: will prioritize PR reviews before cutoff.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reminder set at 02:50 UTC — create release branch + tag.

sophie: :thumbsup: I'll be on standby on the channel and will run smoke tests during EU canary.

marta: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a short checklist and the final times in the release calendar. Ping here if you can't cover your slot.
